# `house_disclosure_filings`

**House filing lookup**

One retained House index line, preserving every filing category and repeated DocID occurrence.

**Coverage.** Sampled. One declared retained index snapshot and explicitly selected periodic transaction report originals. Other categories are discovery only; image-form extraction and source-wide completeness remain unqualified. *(measured 2026-11-13)*

**Data quality.** Native blanks, ranges, repeated index entries and original/amended observations remain separate. Refused reading is not a valid empty report. Page regions retain unqualified checkboxes; annual sections and scanned transactions are outside this pilot.

- **Parquet file:** `house_disclosure_filings.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `filing_id` | `VARCHAR` | Identity of one original index line in one retained index snapshot; repeated DocIDs remain separate observations. |
| `doc_id` | `VARCHAR` | Literal House filing DocID; distinct from a native transaction ID. |
| `filing_type` | `VARCHAR` | Literal filing-category code. P selects periodic transaction reports and does not represent all filings. |
| `prefix` | `VARCHAR` | Literal index name prefix, including blank. |
| `first` | `VARCHAR` | Literal index first name. |
| `last` | `VARCHAR` | Literal index last name. |
| `suffix` | `VARCHAR` | Literal index name suffix, including blank. |
| `state_district` | `VARCHAR` | Literal index StateDst code; no person identifier is inferred. |
| `year_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Original Year cell; index year is separate from filing and transaction dates. |
| `filing_date_raw` | `VARCHAR` | Original index FilingDate cell. |
| `filing_date_status` | `VARCHAR` | parsed, blank or unparsed; original cell remains available. |
| `report_url` | `VARCHAR` | Publisher file route constructed from category, index year and DocID. It does not establish possession or availability. |
| `report_url_basis` | `VARCHAR` | How the file locator was constructed and its availability limit. |
| `index_uri` | `VARCHAR` | Official URL of the retained index ZIP. |
| `index_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 of the exact original index ZIP. |
| `observed_at` | `VARCHAR` | Recorded source capture instant; null when no supported capture time is known. |
| `raw_cells_json` | `VARCHAR` | Ordered original header/value pairs, including blank and unfamiliar fields. |
| `index_year` | `BIGINT` | Selected publisher index year, distinct from the date range of transaction activity. |
| `source_line` | `BIGINT` | One-based physical line in the original yearFD.txt ZIP member. |
| `filing_date` | `DATE` | Parsed index filing date; null with explicit status when blank or unreadable. |
